COURSE

Web Security Foundations

Start with how web applications work, then learn how identity, sessions, and access decisions keep users and data safe.

BeginnerLevel
2Modules
4Lessons
~2hEst. time
0%Progress
0 of 4 lessons completed
Start course
WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

By the end of this course, you will understand:

  • Map assets and trust boundaries in a web application.
  • Read the security-relevant parts of an HTTP request and response.
  • Explain how authentication differs from authorization.
  • Recognize session and access-control risks, and describe defensive controls.
Who this course is for & prerequisites

Beginners, students, and developers who want to understand web security before studying individual vulnerabilities.

Before you start

  • Comfort using a web browser and navigating websites.
  • No previous security-testing experience required. Basic HTML is helpful, not required.
YOUR LEARNING PATH

Course structure

Work through each module in order. Each module builds on the one before it.

4 lessons
01
MODULE 1 · 2 lessons

Understand the web

Build the mental model first: what needs protecting and how requests move through an application.

○ Not started
By the end of this module, you will be able to:

You can trace a request and identify the boundary where a security decision belongs.

01

Web Application Security Fundamentals

A practical introduction to web application security: assets, users, trust boundaries, attack surface, and the difference between a bug and a security vulnerability.

Beginner20 min
Start lesson 02

HTTP Requests & Responses

Understand HTTP methods, URLs, headers, cookies, status codes, request bodies, and why HTTP is the foundation of practical web security testing.

Beginner22 min
Start lesson
02
MODULE 2 · 2 lessons

Protect identity & access

Build on HTTP to understand who a user is, how a session persists, and what that user may do.

○ Not started
By the end of this module, you will be able to:

You can distinguish a login problem from an authorization problem and explain the relevant defenses.

03

Authentication & Session Security

Learn how websites verify identity, maintain sessions, handle passwords and MFA, and where authentication logic can fail.

Beginner24 min
Start lesson 04

Access Control & Authorization

Learn how web applications decide which users can access which data and perform which actions, including horizontal and vertical privilege boundaries.

Beginner24 min

WHEN YOU FINISH

What comes next

Revisit any topic you cannot explain in your own words. Then explore beginner vulnerability labs using the external resources below. This foundation does not cover every vulnerability or qualify you as a professional tester.
